1 .  Criteria 
 
Product Name:Palsonify

12 month(s)  
Therapy Stage 
Initial Authorization  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - Diagnosis of acromegaly  
 
AND 


=== PDF PAGE 1356 ===
Page 1356 
 
2 - One of the following:  
 
 2.1 Patient has an inadequate response to surgery  
 
OR 
 
 2.2 Patient is not a candidate for surgery  
 
AND 
 
3 - Patient has responded to and tolerated treatment with generic octreotide or lanreotide  
 
AND 
 
4 - Prescribed by or in consultation with an endocrinologist  
 
Product Name:Palsonify  
Approval Length 
12 month(s)  
Therapy Stage 
Reauthorization  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - Patient demonstrates positive clinical response to therapy (e.g., clinically significant 
reduction in IGF-1/GH levels, reduction in Total Acromegaly Symptoms Diary (ASD) score)
